title: Burg Method
text: Power spectral density estimate using Burg method, 1 input, 1 output; {Inherit estimation order from input dimensions}, {Estimation order} sets the order of AR model, {Inherit FFT length from estimation order}, {FFT length}, {Inherit sample time from input} and {Sample time of original time series} sets the sample time of original time-domain signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Power spectral density estimate column vector

params.name: Inherit estimation order from input dimensions
params.values: Inherit estimation order from input dimensions off (default) | on

params.name: Estimation order
params.values: Order of AR model 6 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Inherit FFT length from estimation order
params.values: Inherit FFT length from estimation order off (default) | on

params.name: FFT length
params.values: FFT length 256 (default) | positive integer greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Inherit sample time from input
params.values: Inherit sample time from input on (default) | off

params.name: Sample time of original time series
params.values: Sample time of original time-domain signal 1 (default) | positive scalar
